title: Supplementary material of the dissertation "Combining STPA, STRIDE, and LINDDUN PRO to derive cybersecurity and data privacy requirements with LGPD traceability: a smart tourism use case"
description:
Artifacts of the analyses reported in the master's dissertation of Dênis Júnio Zeferino (Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica, ITA, Graduate Program of Mission-Critical Computing, advisor Prof. Dr. Celso Massaki Hirata, 2026). The dissertation applies STPA, derives a data flow diagram from the detailed control structure, analyzes it with STRIDE in the Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool and with LINDDUN PRO, consolidates the controls of the three techniques, and maps the 85 consolidated controls to the applicable articles of the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD).

Version 1.0.2 revises the wording of the README, of the metadata, and of the catalogs, with the same data as version 1.0.1, the first complete version. Version 1.0.0 archived only the root files of the repository by mistake.

Contents: AppSTPA report of the four STPA steps (69 hazardous control actions, 26 loss scenarios); table of LGPD provisions per hazard; causal scenarios workbook; DFD model (.tm7), image, and traceability to the control structure; STRIDE screening, 12 threat groups, 14 controls, and the mitigations registered in the tool (98 records); LINDDUN PRO analysis (315 positions, 107 threats, 24 groups, 71 controls); integrated LGPD matrix (85 controls, 21 common to STPA and 64 added); catalogs in English. The workbooks are in Portuguese; the README explains the conventions and maps every identifier of the dissertation to its file and sheet.
